description: Git Worktree Real Operations - The WorktreeManager already has full real git operations implemented (using asyncio.create_subprocess_exec). Verify the existing test suite passes and add any missing edge case tests for error handling paths.
steps: Run the existing tests/test_worktree.py to confirm the already-implemented WorktreeManager passes all tests (it already uses real git subprocess calls)

Review src/nexus/runtime/worktree.py for any gap between the task requirements and current implementation: (a) verify worktree path convention matches spec (should be <repo_path>/../worktrees/<agent_name>-<short_id>/), (b) verify error handling returns structured errors (not throws) where specified
If the worktree path convention differs from the spec (.nexus-worktrees vs ../worktrees), update to match the spec requirement: <repo_path>/.nexus-worktrees/<agent_id>/

Add missing error handling tests: (a) create_worktree on non-existent repo path, (b) merge_worktree with non-existent branch, (c) remove_worktree on already-removed path, (d) revert_worktree_commit when there is nothing to revert (returns False)
Ensure all git commands are async (already implemented via _run_git_raw with asyncio.create_subprocess_exec)
Update test_worktree.py with any new tests
acceptance_criteria: All existing tests in test_worktree.py pass
WorktreeManager uses real git commands via asyncio.create_subprocess_exec (already done)
Error cases return structured results (False/MergeResult with conflicts) instead of crashing
verification: eval "$(pyenv init -)" && cd /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany && python -m pytest tests/test_worktree.py -x -q
